scope: From IsStickyDatum and dimH(unitFront ambient)<4 alone, construct arbitrarily fine actual normalized directed root graphs, probability sources, and finite pairwise disjoint physical 2r bush source pieces. Every piece has source mass at least r^(3-eta/8); count is at most r^(-3+eta/8). The same original directed G is restricted only to the measurable source union U times univ, retaining all old targets and at least half its mass, hence at least r^(2-eta/8). Exact cover constant is 35/2. Root and captured graphs retain original error r, shell, and closest-time support. Actual affine front lineage, strict front dimension deficit, fixed chart bound, and density tax r^(-eta/8) remain explicit. No graph symmetry, global paid/cross-cap estimate, or moving-limit support transfer is claimed.
